prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create an ENTIRELY NEW Japanese historical-adventure MANGA scene for Episode 02, Tinatin's coronation, in one landscape 16:10 image (ideally 1586 x 992 pixels).

The four attached portraits are ONLY character-identity references, NOT composition or style references: Image1 Rostevan (elderly, long white hair and beard), Image2 Tinatin (young adult woman, long dark wavy hair), Image3 Avtandil (young adult man, dark curls), Image4 Sograt (elderly bearded adviser with turban). Redesign these people as distinctly stylized manga characters; simplify costumes and props freely while keeping their identities and the coronation event.

NEW COMPOSITION: low, dynamic viewpoint from near the kneeling Avtandil. He occupies the LEFT foreground, seen three-quarter from behind with part of his youthful profile visible, one hand against his chest and his gaze lifted toward the queen. He is BAREHEADED, curly hair visible, with a simple dark cloak and readable simplified Eastern armor; no helmet.
Tinatin is the focal figure CENTER-LEFT, seated three-quarter on a raised, angular throne rather than facing squarely toward the viewer. Her posture is open and confident, one hand extended generously toward her court. Rostevan stands on the RIGHT, bareheaded, leaning toward his daughter and carefully lowering ONE crown onto her head. His proud, emotional face and the crown must be clear. Sograt is smaller in the LEFT MIDDLE GROUND beyond Avtandil, smiling in approval with an open-hand gesture. Exactly four people, anatomically coherent, all distinct.

NEW SETTING: a spacious stone palace audience hall with a few large angular pillars, high windows, broad steps and diagonal shafts of light. Use empty paper and a restrained graphic light burst to emphasize the crown and queen. Omit the previous garden, fountain, flowers, patterned domes, thick embroidered borders and all-over fabric ornaments. Clothes remain medieval Georgian/Eastern, with a few distinctive clasps or hems, not Japanese kimono or samurai dress.

UNMISTAKABLE MANGA VISUAL LANGUAGE matching the companion prologue: stylized 2D character designs; expressive manga eyes and brows, simplified noses/mouths; bold hair silhouettes and clear emotional acting; confident varied brush-ink outlines; large solid blacks and clean white negative space; only two or three broad screentone values; strong foreshortening and depth. Thin selective hatching only. It should read like a compelling historical manga splash panel, not an engraving, traced manuscript miniature, photorealistic illustration or grayscale filter. Young characters are adult, not chibi.

Black and white; single landscape illustration, no panel grid. Soft plain paper-white edges. NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, SPEECH BUBBLES, SOUND-EFFECT LETTERING, CAPTIONS, BANNERS, SCROLLS, WATERMARKS OR LOGOS.
mode: new illustration with identity references; complete recomposition

visual_review.style: expressive manga characters, broad black shapes, selective screentones and simplified costumes/backgrounds

selected_scene: A low-angle coronation in a spacious stone hall: bareheaded Avtandil kneels in the left foreground, Tinatin sits on a raised throne with an open generous gesture, bareheaded Rostevan crowns her from the right, and Sograt approves from the left background. Simplified costumes, bold shadows and graphic light behind the crown.
